name: Torrid-Carn
description: Grass-plains and basalt shields alternate across the habitable belt, stitched together by a subterranean ocean. Farther poleward, past massive canyon systems, the silence feels older than the soil.
Standing still, you feel the frozen air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
Debris from the escape pod debris field rings the crash basin in a perfect fan, which ballistics cannot explain. Survivors' accounts disagree about the last hour completely.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
